verdict: Reviewed public per-row parity mask on an amended covered family; constant horizon improvement, no acquisition exponent improvement.

independent_reviews.note: Final independent integration check returned in agent message; public row parity, constant gain and unpaid group gates are distinguished.

paper_results: Determinant-2K parity lattice covers every colour within an enlarged ellipse; completed bank has fewer than 44K rows and admits a unique-support selection with J<=K/3.
Every actual good hit satisfies i=(ell+a+cN)/4 modulo 2, a public row-dependent bit independent of the support colour.
Paid endpoint unit gates give one common q^2 clock after row-dependent shifts.
Constant phase on every lift modulo dyadic b is equivalent to b|2a and cN=a*r*(r+K) modulo Kb; it forces b/2 scaling of a parity-lattice row.
Paired alternating transfer cancels delta in its off-diagonal; a paid polynomial antidifference leaves a moving denominator.
Finite character response, legal reciprocal trace fold and q-Dixon specialization preserve precisely stated targets, but leave long scalar readouts.

acquisition.constant_horizon_gain: Leading bound approximately 1/sqrt(2), before rounding and changed row count.
acquisition.missing: Further useful phase restriction without proportional clock growth, or faster collective evaluation of the remaining response.
